title: Dithered candle

reference.source: Reference 15: dithered gradient illustration of two candle flames, 736 × 1104 px JPEG.
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: Gradient fields for a glow, a cylinder and a flame, each read as a position on a short ramp of inks, screened by one jittered dot lattice so every tone is a mix of whole inks.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 736 × 1104 and every length scales with the canvas

pitch.does: Spacing of the dither lattice; the dots of the lower ink sit at its points.

jitter.does: How far each lattice point is knocked off its grid; 0 is an ordered screen, 1 is a scatter.

span.does: How many ramp steps one dot crosses from its center to its edge; above 1 a dot shows a ring of the middle ink.

candlePitch.does: The candle bodies were dithered on a finer lattice than the background; this is its pitch as a share of the background's.

flamePitch.does: Lattice pitch inside the flames as a share of the background's.

flameGrain.does: Share of per-pixel noise in the flame threshold; the reference's flame shows no lattice at all.

fine.does: Share of the threshold taken from per-pixel noise instead of the lattice; 1 turns the screen into white-noise dither.

sharp.does: 1 keeps every dot hard-edged; lower spreads the ink, as the printed reference does.

glow.does: Distance over which each flame's glow fades into the background.

ambient.does: Where the background sits on its violet-lavender-lime ramp with no flame near; 0 is solid violet.

glowGain.does: How far up the background ramp (violet to lime) the glow pushes.

halo.does: Width of the lime fringe that bleeds from each flame into the background.

heat.does: How far into the flame ramp the core goes; above 1.3 the core goes white.

light.does: Which side of each candle is lit and how strongly; 0 lights the middle only.

fall.does: How quickly the candle darkens below the flame.

candles.does: How many candles stand on the sheet.

flame.does: Height of each flame relative to its candle.

sway.does: How much each flame bends and flickers.

seed.does: Re-rolls the candles, flames and lattice jitter.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Background: violet dots of the lower ink on a lime field, on a lattice of 5.7 px.

techniques.name: Tone
techniques.implementation: Far from the flames the dots grow until violet is the field and lime the dot.

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: Flame edge: lime outside, a lavender band, then pink, each step a dither between two inks.

techniques.name: Pull
techniques.implementation: The halo: lime bleeding into the background for about 34 px around the flame.

pass_order: subject: candles placed along the foot with a radius, a height, a lean and a flame each; nearer candles draw last
fields: the background is the summed glow of the flames; each candle is a cylinder shading with a bright rim under the flame; each flame is a teardrop with a smaller core
ramps: every field is a position on a short ramp of inks (background violet-lavender-lime, candle black-violet-lavender, flame lime-lavender-pink-white)

screen: one jittered dot lattice mixed with fine per-pixel grain gives every pixel a threshold; the fractional ramp position is tested against it, so the lower ink prints as dots that shrink as the field rises
ink spread: a small blur of the printed sheet

background_screen.method: 2-D FFT peaks of a 128 px background patch; the radial profile peaks at 0.16 to 0.18 cycles per px and falls slowly on both sides, so the lattice is jittered

candle_screen.method: weak FFT peaks; the radial profile is a broad ring from 0.14 to 0.26 cycles per px, closer to blue noise

measured.flame: no lattice peak; the radial profile is flat and 1.5 decades below the background, a fine grain smoothed by the file's compression

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Violet lime palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: Candles and flames are generated, so the flame gradient, candle shadow and flame-edge rects were placed with search.py; the background corner and the whole plate compare in place.

limits: Under 98 %: the tone histograms of every patch (0.5 to 0.8) and the black ink color. The reference is a soft JPEG whose dithered dots were blended into continuous tones; this engine prints whole inks and adds a 0.64 px spread, which widens the histogram but not to the reference's.

The flame and candle screens are set as fractions of the background pitch (0.45 and 0.72) with their own grain share and dot span; the reference's flame grain lies below its compression and was not measured directly.
The candles and flames are generated; the reference's pair is not traced.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
This spec follows the controls: open it again, or leave it open, after changing them.
